source.section: TC-40 lines 4 to 22 (Instructions PDF p.9 Line 4; PDF p.10 Lines 5 to 20 and the Line 17 table; PDF p.11 Line 22); (AH) Social Security Benefits Credit and Social Security Credit Worksheet lines 1 to 13 (PDF p.23); (AJ) Military Retirement Credit (PDF p.23) and worksheet lines 1 and 2 (PDF p.24)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = wages (person 0) 25,000.00 + military retirement pay (person 0) 20,000.00 + taxable Social Security 17,000.00 (benefits 20,000.00, from the federal worksheet) = 62,000.00. Federal taxable income = 62,000.00 - standard deduction 15,750.00 = 46,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored; Utah starts from federal AGI). TC-40 (single): line 4 federal AGI 62,000.00. Line 5 additions: none, 0.00. Line 6 = 62,000.00 + 0.00 = 62,000.00. Line 7 state tax refund 0.00. Line 8 subtractions 0.00. Line 9 Utah taxable income = 62,000.00 - 0.00 - 0.00 = 62,000.00. Line 10 = 62,000.00 x 0.045 = 2,790.00. Lines 11 to 16, by the projection: no dependents; the deduction on line 12 is held as the cap 15,750.00; initial credit = 0.06 x min(line 9 62,000.00, cap 15,750.00) = 0.06 x 15,750.00 = 945.00. Line 17 base phase-out amount 18,213.00. Line 18 = max(0, 62,000.00 - 18,213.00) = 43,787.00. Line 19 = 43,787.00 x 0.013 = 569.231. Line 20 = max(0, 945.00 - 569.231) = 375.769. Line 21 worksheet: line 1 federal AGI 62,000.00; line 2 standard deduction 15,750.00; line 3 senior deduction 0.00 (no amount in Utah's sources); line 4 15,750.00; line 5 = max(0, 62,000.00 - 15,750.00) = 46,250.00. Line 5 is above zero, so not exempt; line 21 blank. TC-40A Part 3: Social Security Credit Worksheet: line 1 17,000.00; line 2 0.00; line 3 17,000.00; line 4 = 17,000.00 x 0.045 = 765.00; line 5 line 9 62,000.00; line 6 code 57 0.00; line 7 62,000.00; line 8 tax-exempt interest 0.00; line 9 62,000.00. Line 10 54,000.00; line 11 = max(0, 62,000.00 - 54,000.00) = 8,000.00; line 12 = 8,000.00 x 0.025 = 200.00; line 13 = max(0, 765.00 - 200.00) = 565.00. Military Retirement Credit Worksheet: line 1 20,000.00; line 2 = 20,000.00 x 0.045 = 900.00. Line 22 and TC-40A Part 3: line 20 375.769 + AH 565.000 + AJ 900.000 = 1,840.769; credits 1,840.77. Tax = 2,790.00 - 1,840.77 = 949.23. AH and AJ each name only code 18 as a bar, so they combine (a reading from silence; settlement log). Expected lines are the formula results rounded to the cent at the end (half up); the three-decimal figures above are unrounded.
